proof_scope: entrypoint-backed DAG primitive discovery, directory contract validation, customization, PHART validation, and fail-closed slot handling

claims.proves: agents can find a reusable Tau DAG primitive by intent, inspect its README/Ask prompt/chart/eval/DAG artifacts, materialize a project-specific copy, preserve source metadata, and validate/chart it through phart-dag-chart
claims.does_not_prove: Tau runtime execution, browser/provider behavior, semantic quality of a selected primitive for every possible project, or live cross-repository deployment

cases.name: generated-materialization-real-world
command: D=$(mktemp); ../run.sh materialize immutable-goal-mvp-loop --set dag_id=eval-loop --set goal_id=eval-goal --set goal_hash=sha256:3333333333333333333333333333333333333333333333333333333333333333 --set immutable_goal='Deliver an eval MVP with receipts' --set target_repo=local/agent-skills --set target=dag-template-eval --output "$D" && ../run.sh chart "$D" && test "$(python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); print(d["_template"]["source_id"] + ":" + d["dag_id"])' "$D")" = immutable-goal-mvp-loop:eval-loop
